{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit top: fitted, crew neck, hip length, burgundy #6D1F2F, merino wool
Pleated skirt: A-line, midi to mid-calf, black #1C1C1E, satin-finish crepe
Jacket: tailored, single-breasted, hip length, charcoal #3A3A3F, textured wool-blend tweed
Sheer tights: plain, black #222222, matte nylon
Ankle boots: slim block heel, almond toe, black #1A1A1A, smooth leather
Small crossbody bag: structured, chain strap, antique gold #B08D57, leather
Drop earrings: small, slim teardrop, warm gold #C9A24D, polished metal

This outfit sits right in the neat band while still feeling festive for a Saturday evening party. The rich burgundy knit and the pleated skirt that moves as you walk give the look a celebratory feel, and both will glow nicely in artificial light. The textured jacket adds warmth for a cool autumn night and can come off once you are inside. The block-heel boots keep you comfortable through hours of standing and dancing, and the gold bag and earrings add a subtle sparkle without overdoing it."}
